# App Lab runtime dependencies
# Source of truth for: app_lab/Arduino Safety Monitor/python/requirements.txt
#
# DO NOT add training-only packages (torch, torchvision, onnx, ultralytics).
# DO NOT add test-only packages.
# DO NOT request opencv-python or opencv-python-headless here.
#
# Target runtime: CPython 3.13, Linux aarch64 (Arduino App Lab container)
# Generated by: python app_lab/generate_app_lab.py

# Computer vision — camera capture, frame processing, image encoding
# App Lab base image ghcr.io/arduino/app-bricks/python-apps-base:0.12.0
# already provides a working cv2 module from its own aarch64 CPython 3.13
# OpenCV build. The image constrains that local build version, so requesting
# an OpenCV wheel from PyPI makes dependency resolution unsatisfiable.
# Application code should import cv2 normally from the base image.

# Numerical array operations (camera frames, model input tensors)
numpy

# Image preprocessing for HelmetClassifier (PIL.Image.fromarray)
Pillow

# ONNX inference — PersonDetector (ssd_mobilenet_v1) and HelmetClassifier
onnxruntime

# USB serial communication with the Arduino MCU via BridgeRPC
pyserial

# HTTP alert transmission to the remote monitoring server
requests
